lettuce.label: Lettuce
lettuce.subtitle: Leafy greens
lettuce.description: Fast harvests with modest water and lighting needs.
lettuce.evidenceNote: Cycle and lighting ratios reference ground-based chamber studies; rounded water demand and equipment capacity are game settings.

radish.label: Radish
radish.subtitle: Root crop
radish.description: A quick root crop with modest resource needs.
radish.evidenceNote: Cycle, demand, and yield are provisional game parameters, not lunar measurements.

chili-pepper.label: Chili pepper
chili-pepper.subtitle: Fruiting crop
chili-pepper.description: A fruiting crop that needs a steady supply of water and power.
chili-pepper.evidenceNote: Uses one harvest per batch; repeated picking is not modeled. Values are provisional.

potato.label: Potato
potato.subtitle: Tuber crop
potato.description: A large harvest after a longer growing cycle.
potato.evidenceNote: Cycle begins with prepared plantlets; lighting, water, and dry-biomass ratios reference ground studies.

soybean.label: Soybean
soybean.subtitle: Legume
soybean.description: A longer-cycle legume for a varied crop selection.
soybean.evidenceNote: Cycle, lighting, and yield are provisional balance values pending cultivar-specific calibration.

arabidopsis.label: Arabidopsis
arabidopsis.subtitle: Research plant
arabidopsis.description: Produces research samples only, not food.
arabidopsis.evidenceNote: Cycle, demand, and sample counts are game settings. Research output is separate from food.
